name: SilverTimes Token
oneLiner: STT is STT Assets Limited's Ethereum silver token backed 1:1 by physical LBMA Good Delivery silver vaulted at Brink's Hong Kong.
collateral: Physical LBMA Good Delivery 99.99% fine silver bars (1,019.32330 kg net weight under consignment AG42840, Pallet #11B, 12) vaulted at Brink's Hong Kong Limited in an issuer-described Hong Kong Orphan Trust structure; each token represents one troy ounce of silver
pegMechanism: Each STT tracks one troy ounce of physical silver. KYC-verified holders may mint STT (1% fee; website FAQ notes a 1-ton mint minimum) or redeem for physical LBMA Good Delivery silver bars at a 0.35% redemption fee with typical 3-5 business-day processing (delivery, vault release, and logistics terms remain separate). Monthly issuer Transparency Reports affirm 1:1 backing alongside Brink's Hong Kong holding certificates, without an independent accounting-firm audit or attestation.

proofOfReserves.provider: STT Assets Limited management affirmation backed by Brink's Hong Kong Ltd. vault holding certificates (May 15 and July 15, 2026); no independent accounting firm audit or attestation
